lines: Linda was busy cooking dinner for her daughter, Emma.
The smell of beef stew spread throughout the entire house.
Linda carefully placed a small vase with flowers on the table while humming a song.
She smiled and looked at the clock.
Emma said she would be home by six o’clock.
She was always on time and never broke a promise.
Linda took out her phone and called Emma, but there was no response.
Outside the window, the winter sky was getting dark and the streets were empty.
She tried calling again, but Emma still did not answer.
Linda’s heart started to beat faster.
Her heartbeat was so loud that it filled the silent house.
body.text: It was a quiet evening. Linda was busy cooking dinner for her daughter, Emma. The smell of beef stew spread throughout the entire house. Linda carefully placed a small vase with flowers on the table while humming a song. Everything seemed perfect. She smiled and looked at the clock. It was half past six. Emma said she would be home by six o’clock. She was always on time and never broke a promise. Linda took out her phone and called Emma, but there was no response. Outside the window, the winter sky was getting dark and the streets were empty. She tried calling again, but Emma still did not answer. Linda’s heart started to beat faster. Her heartbeat was so loud that it filled the silent house.
